status: Fixed before neural training; bounded exploratory pilot, not a power analysis
operator_selection: Minimize the mean across seeds of the worst validation-case H1 relative error at xi=0.5, with checkpoint selection by the same validation metric. Test fields and longer horizons do not select a method or checkpoint.
pinn_selection: Compare validation-case endpoint H1 errors at xi=2 separately. Each PINN checkpoint uses residual validation only. Per-instance optimization is required for every new field; PINNs are not ranked as operators.
gate_interpretation: All held-out fields and both seeds at the claimed horizon. Passing is empirical, not a mathematical certificate. The A100 candidate may be selected for further study without passing; any failure must be reported.
cpu_budget: 400 Adam updates per operator or per-instance PINN; slabs divide 400 updates across 4 sequential solves. NLS continuation uses first quarter of updates at epsilon=0. Wall times are measured separately.
deferred: learned long-distance physical validation against HOS or lab data
rigorous interval or a-posteriori existence certification
